table_result.name: //bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/royston-dev-8253/datasets/cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy/tables/loan_applications
table_result.overview: This table stores comprehensive records of financial product applications. It tracks the lifecycle of each application from submission through various stages of approval and funding. The data supports analysis of application volumes, processing times, and the overall flow of financial product requests.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: This column holds the monetary value associated with the application.

fields.name: applied_date
fields.description: This column holds the date when the application was submitted.

fields.name: approved_date
fields.description: This column holds the date when the application received approval.

fields.name: funded_date
fields.description: This column holds the date when the funds for the application were disbursed.

fields.name: closed_date
fields.description: This column holds the date when the application's lifecycle was concluded.

fields.name: application_id
fields.description: This column holds a unique identifier for each loan application.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: This column holds a unique identifier for the customer submitting the application.

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: This column holds the type of financial product being applied for.

queries.sql:
WITH CustomerApplicationCounts AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(application_id) AS total_applications,
    MIN(applied_date) AS first_application_date,
    MAX(applied_date) AS last_application_date,
    DATE_DIFF(MAX(applied_date), MIN(applied_date), DAY) AS days_between_first_and_last
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
  GROUP BY
    customer_id
),
AggregatedStats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(total_applications) AS avg_applications,
    STDDEV(total_applications) AS stddev_applications
  FROM CustomerApplicationCounts
  WHERE days_between_first_and_last <= 30
)
SELECT
  cac.customer_id,
  cac.total_applications,
  cac.first_application_date,
  cac.last_application_date
FROM CustomerApplicationCounts AS cac
CROSS JOIN AggregatedStats AS ags
WHERE
  cac.days_between_first_and_last <= 30
  AND cac.total_applications > ags.avg_applications + (2 * ags.stddev_applications);
queries.description: Find customers who have an unusually high number of loan applications within a short period (e.g., 30 days), indicating potential fraud or unusual activity, by comparing their application count to the average and standard deviation of applications per customer.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  product_type,
  COVAR_POP(amount, DATE_DIFF(closed_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS amount_to_closure_covariance
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE
  closed_date IS NOT NULL AND applied_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY
  product_type
HAVING
  COUNT(application_id) > 1;
queries.description: Calculate the population covariance between the loan amount and the duration from application to closure, for each product type, to understand how these two variables move together within different loan categories.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  product_type,
  CORR(amount, DATE_DIFF(approved_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS amount_to_approval_time_correlation
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE
  applied_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY
  product_type
HAVING
  COUNT(application_id) > 1;
queries.description: Calculate the correlation between the loan amount and the time taken from application to approval, grouped by product type, to understand if larger loans or specific product types have longer approval processes.

queries.sql:
WITH ProductAmountStats AS (
  SELECT
    product_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(amount, 0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type) AS q1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(amount, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type) AS q3
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
),
OutlierThresholds AS (
  SELECT
    product_type,
    q1,
    q3,
    q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1) AS lower_bound,
    q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1) AS upper_bound
  FROM ProductAmountStats
  GROUP BY product_type, q1, q3
)
SELECT
  la.application_id,
  la.product_type,
  la.amount,
  ots.lower_bound,
  ots.upper_bound
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` AS la
JOIN OutlierThresholds AS ots
  ON la.product_type = ots.product_type
WHERE
  la.amount < ots.lower_bound OR la.amount > ots.upper_bound;
queries.description: Identify loan applications where the approved amount is significantly higher or lower than the typical amount for that product type, defined as outside 1.5 times the interquartile range (IQR).

queries.sql:
SELECT
  product_type,
  VAR_SAMP(amount) AS loan_amount_variance,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF(closed_date, approved_date, DAY)) AS avg_approval_to_closure_days
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE
  approved_date IS NOT NULL AND closed_date IS NOT NULL AND applied_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY
  product_type
ORDER BY
  loan_amount_variance DESC, avg_approval_to_closure_days ASC
LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Find the product types with the highest variance in loan amounts and the lowest average time from approval to closure, indicating potentially volatile but efficiently managed product lines.

queries.sql: WITH CustomerAverages AS ( SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS overall_avg_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN funded_date IS NOT NULL THEN amount ELSE NULL END) AS funded_avg_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT customer_id, funded_avg_amount FROM CustomerAverages WHERE funded_avg_amount > overall_avg_amount AND funded_avg_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY funded_avg_amount DESC;
queries.description: Identify customers who have a higher average loan amount for their funded applications compared to their overall average loan amount across all applications, and list their average funded amount.

queries.sql: WITH OverallFundingRate AS ( SELECT CAST(COUNTIF(funded_date IS NOT NULL) AS FLOAT64) / COUNTIF(approved_date IS NOT NULL) AS overall_rate FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ), ProductFundingRates AS ( SELECT product_type, CAST(COUNTIF(funded_date IS NOT NULL) AS FLOAT64) / COUNTIF(approved_date IS NOT NULL) AS product_rate FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY product_type ) SELECT pfr.product_type, pfr.product_rate FROM ProductFundingRates pfr, OverallFundingRate ofr WHERE pfr.product_rate < ofr.overall_rate ORDER BY pfr.product_rate ASC;
queries.description: Find the product types that have a funding rate (funded applications / approved applications) lower than the overall average funding rate, considering applications approved in the last year.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, VAR_SAMP(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, approved_date, DAY)) AS funding_duration_variance FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR) GROUP BY product_type HAVING VAR_SAMP(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, approved_date, DAY)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY funding_duration_variance DESC LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Find the product types with the highest variance in funding duration (time from approved to funded) for applications funded in the last two years.

queries.sql:
WITH MonthlyApprovals AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(applied_date, MONTH) AS application_month,
    product_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS total_applications,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN approved_date IS NOT NULL THEN application_id END) AS approved_applications
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
  WHERE applied_date BETWEEN DATE('2023-01-01') AND DATE('2024-01-01')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ApprovalRates AS (
  SELECT
    application_month,
    product_type,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(approved_applications, total_applications) AS approval_rate,
    LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(approved_applications, total_applications), 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type ORDER BY application_month) AS previous_month_approval_rate
  FROM MonthlyApprovals
)
SELECT
  application_month,
  product_type,
  approval_rate,
  previous_month_approval_rate,
  (approval_rate - previous_month_approval_rate) AS approval_rate_change
FROM ApprovalRates
ORDER BY product_type, application_month;
queries.description: Analyze the monthly approval rate of loan applications for each product type, comparing it to the previous month's rate.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, MAX(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, approved_date, DAY)) AS max_approval_to_funding_gap FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM approved_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM funded_date) GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY max_approval_to_funding_gap DESC;
queries.description: For each product type, find the maximum gap in days between an application being approved and then funded, considering only applications approved and funded within the same calendar year.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF(closed_date, funded_date, DAY)) AS avg_funding_to_closure_days
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE
  funded_date IS NOT NULL AND closed_date IS NOT NULL AND applied_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY
  customer_id
ORDER BY
  total_approved_amount DESC, avg_funding_to_closure_days ASC
LIMIT 3;
queries.description: Identify the top 3 customers who have the highest total approved loan amount and the lowest average time from funding to closure across all their loans.

queries.sql:
WITH QuarterlyFundedAmounts AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(funded_date, QUARTER) AS funding_quarter,
    SUM(amount) AS total_funded_amount,
    MAX(funded_date) AS last_funded_date
  FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
  WHERE funded_date BETWEEN DATE('2023-01-01') AND DATE('2024-01-01')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
RankedCustomers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    funding_quarter,
    total_funded_amount,
    last_funded_date,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY funding_quarter ORDER BY total_funded_amount DESC) AS rank_in_quarter
  FROM QuarterlyFundedAmounts
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  funding_quarter,
  total_funded_amount,
  last_funded_date
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rank_in_quarter <= 5
ORDER BY funding_quarter, rank_in_quarter;
queries.description: Identify the top 5 customers with the highest cumulative funded amount within each quarter, showing their total funded amount and the date of their last funded loan.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, AVG(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS avg_funding_duration_days, STDDEV(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS stddev_funding_duration_days FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY avg_funding_duration_days DESC;
queries.description: Calculate the average time taken from application to funding for each product type, considering only applications that were both approved and funded, and also show the standard deviation of this duration.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM applied_date) AS application_year,
  product_type,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF(approved_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS avg_days_to_approve,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, approved_date, DAY)) AS avg_days_to_fund
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE applied_date BETWEEN DATE('2023-01-01') AND DATE('2024-01-01')
  AND approved_date IS NOT NULL
  AND funded_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
queries.description: Calculate the average time taken from application to approval and from approval to funding for each product type, broken down by year.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, APPROX_QUANTILES(amount, 100)[OFFSET(75)] AS p75_approved_unfunded_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NULL GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY p75_approved_unfunded_amount DESC;
queries.description: Calculate the 75th percentile of the loan amount for applications that were approved but not yet funded, grouped by product type.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM applied_date) AS application_year, APPROX_QUANTILES(amount, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_approved_unfunded_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NULL GROUP BY product_type, application_year ORDER BY application_year DESC, product_type ASC;
queries.description: Calculate the median loan amount for applications that were approved but not yet funded, broken down by product type and the year of application.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, funded_date, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type ORDER BY funded_date) AS cumulative_funded_amount FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE funded_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY product_type, funded_date;
queries.description: Calculate the cumulative sum of funded amounts over time for each product type, ordered by funded date.

queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_funded_amount, COUNT(application_id) AS funded_applications_count FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_funded_amount DESC LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Determine the top 5 customers with the highest total funded amount across all their approved and funded loan applications, along with the count of their funded applications.

queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT product_type ORDER BY product_type) AS distinct_product_types FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) > 1 ORDER BY customer_id;
queries.description: Identify customers who have applied for more than one loan product type and have at least one approved loan, showing their customer ID and the distinct product types they applied for.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, MAX(CASE WHEN funded_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF(funded_date, approved_date, DAY) WHEN closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF(closed_date, approved_date, DAY) ELSE NULL END) AS max_approved_duration_days FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` WHERE approved_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY max_approved_duration_days DESC;
queries.description: Determine the maximum number of days an application remained in 'approved' status before being funded or closed, for each product type.

queries.sql: SELECT product_type, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-Q%Q', applied_date) AS application_quarter, COUNTIF(closed_date IS NOT NULL AND funded_date IS NULL) * 100.0 / COUNT(application_id) AS percentage_closed_unfunded FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications` GROUP BY product_type, application_quarter HAVING COUNT(application_id) > 0 ORDER BY application_quarter DESC, percentage_closed_unfunded DESC;
queries.description: Determine the percentage of applications that are closed without being funded, grouped by product type and the quarter of the application.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  AVG(amount) AS average_loan_amount,
  STDDEV_SAMP(amount) AS loan_amount_std_dev,
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(funded_date, applied_date, DAY)) AS max_application_to_funding_days
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE
  applied_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY
  customer_id
HAVING
  COUNT(application_id) > 1;
queries.description: Determine the average loan amount, its standard deviation, and the maximum time taken from application to funding, for each customer, but only for customers who have applied for more than one loan.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  approved_date,
  product_type,
  SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type ORDER BY approved_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30_day_approved_amount
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.loan_applications`
WHERE approved_date BETWEEN DATE('2023-01-01') AND DATE('2024-01-01')
GROUP BY approved_date, product_type, amount
ORDER BY product_type, approved_date;
queries.description: Determine the rolling 30-day average of the total amount of approved loans, segmented by product type.
